install_steps: Verify the downloaded DMG or ZIP against the release checksums.
Open the DMG and drag Cortex.app to Applications.
If macOS blocks an unnotarized local beta, Control-click Cortex.app and choose Open.
Complete getting started by connecting a memory source, reviewing one memory, asking a cited question, then deciding on backup in Connections & Privacy.
known_limitations: Manual app replacement is the only update path for this local beta.

External agents connect over the local MCP server (Claude Desktop/Code, Cursor, VS Code) or the universal HTTP tool API; ChatGPT/web apps connect via the Cortex browser extension (local bridge). Hosted remote MCP + OAuth is not enabled.
GitHub connects with browser sign-in; Google, Notion, and Outlook managed OAuth still require configured OAuth app credentials in the app build.
Hosted accounts and cloud backup are not enabled.
Developer ID signing, notarization, hosted HTTPS downloads, and a support process are required before broad public distribution.
manual_qa_checklist: Install from the DMG on a clean macOS 13 or newer user profile.
Launch from Applications and complete first-run setup.
Connect a memory source in Connections & Privacy and approve at least one memory.
Point Claude Desktop or Cursor at the local MCP server and ask a question that returns cited memory.
From an OpenAI/Anthropic function-calling app, fetch /v1/tools/schema and call a tool.
Menu bar → 'Connect browser extension' + 'Copy API connection info', then inject cited context into ChatGPT/Claude.ai.
Replace the app over a previous build and confirm the memory folder remains intact.
rollback_steps: Keep the user's memory folder unchanged.
Replace Cortex.app in Applications with the previous beta build.
Relaunch, run the reliability report, and create a fresh backup.
update_steps: Quit Cortex before replacing the app.
Install the new Cortex.app over the old app in Applications.
Relaunch, confirm backend health, and run the reliability report.

release_notes: Connect Cortex to your other apps from the menu bar: 'Connect browser extension' pairs the extension, and 'Copy API connection info' hands you a read-only token + endpoints + a ready-to-run example for any function-calling app or the Cortex SDK.
Cortex now learns from use: it records which cited memories agents actually rely on (locally, feature-vectors only) to improve future ranking.
Carries the full external-connection stack from build 13 (MCP + universal HTTP tool API + SDK + browser extension + delivery) with task-aware retrieval on by default.
